question: An engineer must configure OSPF routing on Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switches. The IP subnet of the Eth1/2 interfaces for both switches must be advertised via OSPF. However, these interfaces must not establish OSPF adjacency or send routing updates. The current OSPF adjacency over the interfaces Eth1/1 on SW1 and Eth1/1 on SW2 must remain unaffected. Which configuration must be applied to both Nexus switches to meet these requirements?
options:
interface ethernet 1/2
  ip ospf network point-to-point

interface ethernet 1/2
  no ip ospf passive-interface
